[EN] I am so sick of Allosh's constant talk. He won't discuss strategy and he doesn't care about his career. All he does is talk about his folks or what lass has spurned him this time.
[ES] Estoy tan harto de la cháchara constante de Allosh. No quiere hablar de estrategia y no le importa su carrera. Lo único que hace es hablar de sus padres o de qué muchacha lo ha rechazado esta vez.
